in_sanskrit.name: हिमन्सा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess of the Tiger, Goddess of Fierce Protection

in_marathi.name: Himanshi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Himanshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। She who is moon-like, resembling the goddess Hima or the radiant moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon god is considered a symbol of peace, tranquility, and the passage of time.

in_bengali.name: Himanshi
in_bengali.long_meaning: Himanshi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। She who is moon-like, resembling the goddess Hima or the radiant moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon god is considered a symbol of peace, tranquility, and the passage of time.
